main_measure.name: mean 20-bar forward return on short bars minus on all bars (pp)
main_measure.threshold: confirm if difference <= -2 percentage points with t <= -2; reject if difference >= 0

supporting_check.name: hit rate on short bars minus unconditional share of negative 20-bar returns (pp)

decided_by: Reject: the short-bar hit rate is not above the unconditional share.
reading: Short bars are grid bars (positions 0, 20, 40, ... of each window) with forecast < 0 compared against all grid bars of the same windows, both groups taking the Welch t, and the 'largest-tertile shorts' are the ceil(n/3) short cases with the most negative forecast; the minimum-count rule is applied before the reject and confirm rules.
